test_title: PYST 07: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Transform the following sentence into active voice:

Let the mobile be charged.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "Let the mobile be charged."
 
• To convert to active voice: Identify the implied subject (e.g., "You" or "Someone").
 
• Change the verb structure to its active form: "Charge the mobile."
 
• Ensure the sentence conveys the same instruction or meaning as the original.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Charge the mobile."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"One must charge the mobile." – This is grammatically correct but includes an unnecessary subject.
 
• **Option 3: **"Someone should charge the mobile." – This changes the modality of the sentence, introducing "should."
 
• **Option 4: **"Will you charge the mobile?" – This changes the intent to a question.
